    What we are looking for

    The short version: a house we can host people in, with a bit of extra room, under $800,000, in the Whittier / Hacienda Heights school area. Everything on the other tabs is already filtered to the first two numbers. This is what separates a yes from a maybe.

    Must have

    • 3 bedrooms, 2 baths minimum
    • 1,200+ sqft. We have passed on places where the rooms were smaller than our current apartment. 1,500+ is scarce, so 1,200 is the floor
    • Under $800,000. We know this is the hard part right now
    • Within a 20-minute drive of our kid's school in Hacienda Heights — 15 minutes is the ideal, 20 is the most you will entertain. The minutes on each card are Google Maps “leave now” times pulled during the evening rush (Tue Sep 15, 2026, 4:55–5:40 PM (evening rush)), with the free-flow estimate shown alongside when it differs; green ✓ = 15 or under, gold = 16–20, red = over the line
    • Whittier, Hacienda Heights, La Puente, La Habra, Avocado Heights, Rowland Heights, West Covina or Covina
    • No air-quality or environmental problems nearby

    Strongly prefer

    • 4 bedrooms, or a permitted second unit / ADU
    • A living room that fits a large TV and a lot of seating. We host constantly; this is the room that decides it
    • A larger primary bedroom than the usual tract layout
    • Central air. Split units are fine, window units are not
    • Lower-crime streets
    • Indoor laundry

    Nice to have

    • Walking distance to shops and restaurants. I walk a lot
    • Move-in ready over needs-work
    • Kitchen already updated
    • Open to unpermitted garage conversions. Just tell us up front so we can price in the permit and appraisal side
    • Fruit trees — an avocado above all, and a lemon. A mature avocado tree is close to a tiebreaker
    • A usable backyard, not a dirt slope
    • No carpet — hardwood, laminate or tile preferred
    • A bigger lot

    Dealbreakers

    • Gated communities. Guest parking makes hosting a large group almost impossible
    • Tiny rooms, however good the finishes are
    • Washer and dryer outside
    • Steep hillside lots with no flat yard
    • Rough street: packed parking, junk in the yards next door

    One number replaces both rules

    $667/sqft

    Under $800,000 and over 1,200 sqft is the same statement as under $667 per square foot. $800,000 ÷ 1,200 = $667. One column does the work of both limits, which is why every list here sorts that way.

    The market median across all listings is $/sqft. Median size under $800k is sqft; at $800k and up it jumps to sqft. That jump is the cliff this page is named for.

    Where everything sits

    In range, suggested On your watchlist Passed Everything else

    Sort by the foot, not the price

    Sorting by list price shows you small houses first. Two houses can both read as “about $750k” and be 1,766 and 1,048 square feet.

    Let a permitted ADU be the 4th bedroom

    Few houses in range have 4+ bedrooms. A permitted second unit widens the pool a lot, but the permit is the whole thing.

    Check HOA and “gated” before getting excited

    Cheap-per-foot and big has twice meant an attached PUD behind a gate with a large HOA. Read that line before touring.

    Listed sqft can bundle the ADU

    8410 Alburtis is 1,400 sqft of house plus a 588 sqft unit. Ask what the number includes before comparing $/sqft.

    Walk Score points at Uptown Whittier

    The 90601/90602 side has a real walkable downtown. OneHome prints a score on every listing; read it before committing a Saturday.

    Decide what $800k really means

    Tick “Include up to $850k” on the Suggested tab and the shelf changes. Worth knowing whether the line is a wall or a preference.
